mandate: C294 — pre-registered costed OOS sweep of a NEW asset class: real implied volatility (Deribit DVOL) variance-risk-premium / BTC-vs-ETH relative-value stat-arb on 1h bars. 3 features x 3 lookbacks x 3 holds = 27 runs (K=2, effective per-leg K=1 for a 2-asset cross-section); train=720/test=168/step=168 1h bars; cost grid [[0,0],[5,5],[10,10],[20,20],[40,40]] bps on BOTH legs; PRIMARY real spot relative-value PnL (real Binance BTC/ETH 1h returns) + DIAGNOSTIC variance-swap-proxy leg (executed_fills=false); BTC-vs-ETH B&H and always-long-vol (short VRP) B&H benchmarks; edge rule identical to C285/C286/C288/C290/C291/C292/C293.

config.cost_rule: tc * sum|dw| across both legs (BTC and ETH), charged on BOTH legs
config.pnl_primary: w_btc*r_btc - w_eth*r_eth from real Binance BTC/ETH 1h returns

score_definition.iv_rv_spread: DVOL - trailing annualized realized vol over L 1h bars (per asset)
score_definition.iv_z: rolling z(DVOL) over L 1h bars (per asset)
score_definition.dvol_x_spread: z(DVOL_BTC - DVOL_ETH) over L 1h bars; BTC=+z, ETH=-z

config.signal_direction: higher score = long that asset (pairwise long top-1 / short bottom-1)
